bio.text: Monica Duran is a Democrat who represents District 23 (Jefferson County) in the Colorado House of Representatives and serves as its Majority Leader, according to the Colorado General Assembly; Ballotpedia lists her as a 2026 candidate for Colorado State Senate District 22.

According to Ballotpedia, her career experience includes work in the dental industry, and she has served on the Wheat Ridge City Council, on the board of the Jefferson Center for Mental Health, and as director of the Wheat Ridge Fire Protection Board.
